name: How long can I typically stay in my home after selling it through this program?

mainEntity.name: How long can I typically stay in my home after selling it through this program?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration you can stay in your home after selling is highly negotiable and depends on the buyer's flexibility and your specific needs. Leaseback periods can range from a few weeks to several months, or even longer in some cases, often subject to state-specific tenancy laws. The practical tradeoff is that longer leaseback periods might limit your pool of potential buyers, as some buyers require immediate occupancy, impacting the timing of the sale.
acceptedAnswer.description: The leaseback duration is negotiable, typically from weeks to several months, and depends on buyer flexibility and your needs.
